source.section: III.D.1 (p.19), third of four sentences of the timetable text
source.quote_free_summary: The first event of the day must not start ahead of its scheduled time.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must show a proposed change that would start the first event of the day early as a preventable scheduling violation (acknowledgment and reason), and record the actual first start.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation. Needs the time model and a definition of 'first event of the day' per floor and day.
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED and a profile blocker. 'First event of the day' per floor and per day is not defined in the text read (Q2).
